in_sanskrit.name: Ashaka
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Horse
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ashaka एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ashaka is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘asha’ meaning ‘hope’ and ‘kha’ meaning ‘horse’. This name is associated with the goddess Ashwini, who is known to ride horses and bestows blessings upon her devotees.
